title: Haye Haye Ali Akbar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
body:
Haye Haye Ali Akbar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
Kehti thi yeh maa khoon bhari maiyyat sey lipatt kar
<<MINI>>
Haye Haye Ali Akbar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Armaan tha pehnaaoongi poshaak shahaani
Afsous kay raas aayi na tujhko yeh jawaani
Kaisa tha muqaddar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Ithnaa toh zaraa tehro tumhein dulhaa banaa loon
Bus ek jhalak sehray ki Sughra ko dikhaa loon
Bey chaen thi khwaahar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Atthaara baras paal kay parwaan chaddhaaya
Woh gaisuoun waala hai mera khoon mein nahaaya
Yeh kya huva dilbar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
Maa teri judaayi mein bhalaa kaisey jiyegi
Mar jaayegi Sughra jo khabar teri suneygi
Ab kya karoon jee kar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tehro kay maen atthaarween mannath toh baddhaa doon
Ley ley kay balaayein tujhey jeenay ki dua doon
Sadqey ho yeh maadar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Pehlay toh ek aawaaz pey utt jaatey thay beta
Ab ithni sadaaoun pey bhi pehloo nahin badlaa
Kya hogaya dilbar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Karti thi ziyaarat maen Payambar ki tujhee sey
Ab ghar mein kisey doongi maen tashbeeh Nabi sey
Hum Shakl-e-Payambar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Tum hichkiyaan ley-ley kay jo dam tordd rahey ho
Munh Maa sey hameishaa kay liye mordd rahey ho
Kyun rootthey ho dilbar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayein jo hamein lootney khaimey mein sitamgar
Maa dey gi sadaa-e-Ali Akbar, Ali Akbar
Chinn jaayegi chaadar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab koyi jawaan laash nazar aati hai Mehshar
Ek yaad suwey Karbobalaa jaati hai Mehshar
Dil rothaa hai kehkar, Haye Haye Ali Akbar
